ballots.name: Priya
ballots.reason: Lintwise caught real bugs on my previous team but added about four minutes to CI, so I favor a non-blocking trial before requiring it here.

ballots.name: Marcus
ballots.reason: I support a non-blocking trial to measure build-time and queue impact before making Lintwise a required pre-merge check.

ballots.name: Elena
ballots.reason: We should verify secrets and dependency coverage and measure CI impact in a non-blocking trial before requiring Lintwise.

ballots.name: Tom
ballots.reason: I support a non-blocking trial on our monorepo to measure JavaScript noise and CI overhead before making Lintwise mandatory.

ballots.name: Sana
ballots.reason: I have not used Lintwise and want a non-blocking trial to verify its value for our Python and SQL pipelines before making it mandatory.

ballots.name: Lars
ballots.reason: We should validate Lintwise’s signal, false-positive noise, and CI impact in a non-blocking monorepo trial before requiring it for merges.

ballots.name: Jin
ballots.reason: I support a non-blocking trial before requiring merge checks, with local evidence, clear rule-specific enforcement, exceptions, and a rollback path.

ballots.name: Olga
ballots.reason: I support a non-blocking trial with clear developer guidance before making Lintwise a required merge check.
